g: Worth buying, with fifteen days left
note: If you buy only three things, about ₹1,350 in total, or about ₹600 using the free Parmar mocks instead of Testbook. Everything else below is a skip: too long to finish in fifteen days, or it repeats these.

items.title: Pinnacle SSC CGL Tier 1 2026, 4800 MCQ chapter-wise
items.what: Every question from all CGL 2025 shifts, the new vendor's pattern, sorted by chapter for all four sections. The single best buy.

items.title: Testbook Pass, one year
items.what: CGL 2025 past papers in the exam interface plus live all-India mocks. Worth it if you want more than about six full mocks.

items.title: Parmar SSC Current Affair Shot 2026
items.what: Compact, SSC-filtered current affairs to about July 2026. Top up August and September with the Parmar monthly videos.

items.title: Parmar All India Mega Mock Test 2026, 17 free
items.what: 17 full CGL mocks, free with a login. Enough on their own if you skip Testbook.

items.title: GK Now, last six months current affairs
items.what: March to August 2026, 219 pages with 600+ MCQs. The best free alternative to the Parmar book.

items.title: Pinnacle General Studies 6500+
items.what: Only if GA is your weakest section and you will do about 300 GA questions a day. Otherwise the 4800 book already covers it.

items.title: Skip: Lucent, NCERT reading, Neetu Singh, Blackbook, 6800/7600 subject books, Adda247 Mahapack, any app course
items.what: Good books for a long preparation. None can be finished in fifteen days, and the Mahapack alone is ₹7,138.

note: SSC moved the exam from TCS to Eduquity from CGL 2025, so the 2025 shifts are the closest match to your paper. This site holds all 36 shifts of 2024 as timed mocks; do the 2025 ones from the first two links.

items.what: The real SSC response sheets for 12-26 Sep 2025 and the 14 Oct re-exam, correct option marked. Scanned, so print or read on screen.

items.title: CGL 2025 GA section only, all 46 shifts
items.what: 488 pages: every GA question from last year's exam with the key. The best single GA resource there is.
